name: Mint Aluminum Nursing Clipboard with Cheat Sheets
seoTitle: Nursing School Clipboard with Cheat Sheets
metaDescription: A mint aluminum foldable nursing clipboard with nursing and medical cheat sheets, a practical nursing school gift for clinical days and beyond.
summary: A mint folding clipboard with nursing and medical cheat sheets, built for students heading into clinicals and new nurses finding their rhythm.
whyItWorks: The first clinical day is a lot. Students are handed a patient, a report sheet, and an instructor who wants to hear assessment findings, all while trying to remember normal lab values. A folding clipboard with nursing and medical reference sheets gives them a steady place to write and a quick check for the basics.

It works as a back to school gift at the start of a nursing program, a reward after surviving the first semester, or a starter tool in a pinning ceremony basket. The aluminum build folds closed to protect notes and fits better in a pocket than a full size board. Mint is a calm, friendly color that stands out on a crowded counter. Bundle it with a penlight, a watch with a second hand, or a pack of highlighters, and you have a set of supplies a student will actually reach for. Working nurses who like having references close at hand will find it useful too, on any unit.
goodToKnow: Check the listing photos to see what the cheat sheets cover.
Reference sheets are reminders, not a replacement for facility policy.
It is especially helpful for students in their first year of clinicals.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a student starting nursing school?
faq.a: Yes, it is aimed squarely at clinical days, when students are writing constantly and learning reference values.

faq.q: How is it different from other folding clipboards?
faq.a: Most folding nursing clipboards are similar. Compare the cheat sheet content and color on the listing to choose the best fit.
